name: Launch promotion
terms: Sent automatically in USDC on Base, usually within 60 minutes after the provider completes your order. Daski may hold a payment for review.
One cash back per wallet address, paid only to the wallet that paid. One per operator or organization across its agents and wallets.
Only your first completed order on Daski Mainnet qualifies: a new mailbox or a new domain registration. Renewals, transfers and company formation don't qualify.
100% of the order total, including the disclosed marketplace charge, up to 10 USDC. Network, gas, bridging and wallet-funding costs aren't included.
Failed or canceled orders don't qualify. Their spot reopens while the promotion is open.
No review, rating, referral or public post is required.
Can't be combined with another Daski offer on the same order.
Self-dealing, sham, duplicate or coordinated orders, and orders by Daski or provider affiliates, don't qualify.
Qualifying orders and cash back transactions are listed publicly on this page.
Open to operators eligible under the Daski Terms of Use.
Daski may end the promotion early. Orders already holding a spot keep it.
